why_this_is_defensible: The selected file is the last upstream pre-cleanup diabetes model on origin/investment-case. The subsequent local commits 09c32ba, 102e6dd, and fd51b08 are cleanup commits that deliberately replaced the old monolithic surface with the current module-contract surface.
The file is a complete executable-style botech model with runtime, nodes, links, and subroutines. It has 210 nodes, 294 links, 56 subroutines, runtime 2025-2046, and synchronous_iterations 10.

The graph contains the old monolithic wiring families that cleanup needed to preserve for audit, including diabetes disease states, population/demographic mechanics, tobacco, alcohol, physical-inactivity and fiber risk-factor paths, DALY/YLD/YLL and economic output paths, clinical diabetes interventions, and resource/population-reached nodes.

The same bytes also appear at diabetes commit 1628ec449295038ec6fbdc873b58ed8b0e20d663, so d9bc894 is not a one-off generated variant; it preserves the June 2026 transition-system monolith at the pre-cleanup branch tip.

model_assurance_evidence.summary: The optional model-assurance repository is on a working branch with a large untracked assurance tree, so it is not used as primary provenance. It does provide low-weight corroboration that June 2026 assurance material referred to ncd-diabetes component boundaries, model cards, run certificates, and Appendix 3 diabetes scenarios.

rejected_alternatives.reason_rejected: A plausible September 2025 investment-case-era monolith near the upload results, but it predates the 2025 runtime horizon, population bridge, transition-system method, and June 2026 pre-cleanup branch-tip state. It is less useful as the reference for behavior potentially lost during the June 2026 cleanup.
Includes the 2025-2046 runtime horizon but predates later absolute population/resource bridge and transition-system changes; the graph is smaller at 205 nodes, 279 links, and 54 subroutines.
Tagged early risk-factor implementation with a smaller, older graph and no burden/economic output family; useful history but not the fullest legacy monolith needed for cleanup parity.
Those files are generated modular-composition artifacts, not the single legacy monolithic source model requested for this reference specimen.

uncertainty: The upload repository evidence is moderate rather than exact: it links diabetes repository outputs and systems-dynamics model results to the stitching workflow, but does not contain the exact Saving Lives, Spending Less phrase in reachable git history.

The selected June 2026 monolith is later than the September 2025 result CSV referenced by the upload repository. It is selected because the requested cleanup-parity specimen is best represented by the last pre-cleanup monolithic diabetes model, not because the upload repository proves exact byte-for-byte production of that CSV.

The legacy graph contains cross-domain internals by design. That is recorded for audit only and must be re-expressed through current module contracts and compiler-owned composition if any behavior is still required.
